body:
Adds `research/expert-pooling`: pooling calibrated experts with correlated errors (shared training data).

- Closed-form Bayes-optimal logit exponent a* = n/(1+(n-1)rho), checked against a numerical argmin of the exact expected log-loss
- Saturation of gains at n_eff -> 1/rho, comparison of pooling rules, asymmetric robustness to misspecified extremization
- rho estimator from labelled logits and online gradient descent on the exponent
- Pure-Python, 6 unit tests, white paper, portfolio page and root README entries
